answer: A scripted farm therefore has to pad 72 submissions and hold each identity open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which forfeits the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. Because the timing is written down against the comet challenge, the mesa audit can replay the karst history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. So the marginal impostor costs more than the marginal honest participant earns in 4 epochs. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
